title: spawnRailedChild's path limit does not resolve links
severity_rationale: S4, equal to the estimate: the check is a pre-spawn convenience; the child rails are the enforcement.

evidence.note: realpath only on existing directories; a symlink file in an argument is resolved lexically

sibling_sites_checked: The child still gets the preload, so the data and .env blocks fire in the child at the setup layer regardless of how the path is spelled.
recommendation: Leave unless the rail rewrite happens.
